notes: Reference-guided modular courtyard revision. Rejected opaque checkerboard drafts are not used.
prompts: Use the attached reference as strict style reference, not as a compositional image to reproduce. Create a reusable seamless square ground texture for that exact game scene. Overhead orthographic painted ground only: SMALL broken irregular pale grey courtyard cobbles, compact dust and gritty rubble, subtle olive moss in crevices. There should be approximately 35 to 45 small stones across the image width; NOT huge flagstones. Matching the reference's soft ash grey midtones, painterly brush edges, muted cold daylight, low contrast, rich natural unevenness. Edge to edge flat ground texture, no shadows from external objects, no walls, no characters, no circular patterns, no UI, no borders. 2D painted game texture. Completely flat lighting so repeated tiles are invisible.

Use the attached reference as strict visual style and lighting reference. Generate ONE production 2D environment sprite, isolated on a genuinely transparent background: a massive ruined medieval WHITE-GREY limestone fortress gate facade, horizontal, an open central passage framed by high broken towers, dark iron gate doors open to the sides, two long weathered dark wine-red banners, fractured edges and scattered stone at feet, small wooden spikes near sides. Exactly the cold grey painterly quality, realistic scale, weathered stone brushwork, fixed elevated 55-degree orthographic game camera of the attached image. We see the front and upper surfaces; facade front edge runs horizontally, NOT a diamond/isometric tile. Gate width 3 times its height. No ground plane extending outside the footprint, no background mountains or sky, no people or creatures, no UI, no text, no giant decorative gold. Sprite alone, centered fully inside frame with 4% padding. Preserve richly detailed rubble and torn cloth.

Use the attached image as a STRICT style and projection reference. Tall broken cold ash-grey limestone battlements, repeated piers and gothic wall fragments, faded dark burgundy hanging banners, old timber spikes, a broken cart wheel, two barrels, torn grey canvas and fallen stone clustered at the foot on the RIGHT / inward-facing side. An irregular medieval silhouette with fine painterly detail matching the reference. Long vertical strip, about 1:2 aspect ratio. The wall runs from top toward bottom of the image, the accessible courtyard would be to its RIGHT, but do NOT draw the courtyard. Do not draw a square slab or a tile base. No people, no monsters, no sky, no text, no UI. Everything fully inside frame with narrow clear padding. Light from upper left, soft baked contact shading within objects.
